title: Cabinet reshuffle unlikely to delay passage of budget bill — Ejercito
summary: A reshuffle in President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s Cabinet is not likely to slow down passage of the proposed 2027 national budget, Sen. JV Ejercito, chair of the Senate Finance Committee, said.
